big_case.notes: Overton sought to halt his imminent execution. A ruling on an alleged categorical exclusion from clemency or on access to clemency records could affect other Florida prisoners under death warrants. The Court disposed of the application and petition without announcing a rule.

leakage.notes: The forward log ends November 18, before the November 19 order. Its queries concern the November 17 snapshot and briefs, Woodard, Barwick and earlier dispositions. Barwick is the dated 2023 result. Some call results are unobserved, but neither the queries nor the rationale discloses Overton’s disposition.
